name: What Happens Under Carpet: Subfloor Prep and Tack Strip
title-tag: Carpet Subfloor Prep & Tack Strip Explained | Duvall WA
meta-description: Tear-out day is the only day anyone sees your subfloor. Squeaks, soft spots, pet damage and tack strip — what proper prep fixes, and why we price it when found.
post-summary: March 25, 2027 · The morning old carpet comes up is the only chance in a decade to fix what it was hiding: squeaks get screwed down, soft spots opened up, pet-soaked plywood sealed or replaced, tack strip inspected instead of assumed. What proper prep includes, and why honest installers price it when found — at unit rates named up front.
